title: The Listening Visitor
author: Yara Oyelaran
blurb: Yara Montrose, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the well refills.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
